When a young English solicitor arrives at a remote Carpathian castle to assist a strange aristocratic client, he unwittingly becomes a prisoner in a realm of supernatural dread. As the ancient predator boards a merchant ship bound for the shores of England, a trail of terror and mysterious affliction follows in his wake. A dedicated band of men and women, united by science and faith, must piece together a harrowing puzzle of diary entries and telegrams to hunt the monster before he claims the soul of a cherished bride.
